# SealQL

Start: docs/current-state.md, then docs/llm-integration.md
Drizzle schema and key setup: examples/standard-consumer.ts
Raw SQL through Drizzle: examples/standard-raw.ts
Managed writes and count: examples/standard-operations.ts
Key loading: examples/key-loader.ts
Exports: package.json, src/index.ts, src/adapters/drizzle/v0.45/index.ts
Security limits: docs/threat-model.md
Decisions and evidence: docs/decisions/README.md
Contributor rules: AGENTS.md

Current search is standard HMAC pieces, GIN/B-tree candidate indexes, and authenticated plaintext verification. Define encrypted columns with `sealed.text` and related builders, then call `sealed.register(table, { row, scope? })`; export the returned companion table to drizzle-kit. Use `sealed.insert/update/upsert` for encrypted writes, `sealed.open` for Drizzle results, and `sealed.openRaw` for raw `db.execute` results. `findMany`, `count`, and `search` support sealed predicates and `m.sql` for ordinary SQL. `count` returns an exact number or errors at its candidate budget. Raw encrypted-column writes bypass token maintenance. There is no `sealql/postgres` export or stateful search mode.
